using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Orleans.Storage;
using Orleans.Runtime;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Storage.Tests
{
    public class AzureTableGrainStorageFactoryTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void Create_CallsGetRequiredServiceForIOptionsMonitor()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            var optionsMonitorMock = new Mock<IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>>();
            services.Setup(s => s.GetRequiredService<IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>>())
                    .Returns(optionsMonitorMock.Object);

            var clusterOptionsMock = new Mock<ClusterOptions>();
            services.Setup(s => s.GetProviderClusterOptions(It.IsAny<string>()))
                    .Returns(clusterOptionsMock.Object);

            var activatorUtilitiesMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>(); // Simplified for test focus

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => AzureTableGrainStorageFactory.Create(services.Object, "test-provider"));
            
            // Verify the specific GetRequiredService call was made
            services.Verify(s => s.GetRequiredService<IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>>(), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Create_WhenIOptionsMonitorNotRegistered_ThrowsInvalidOperationException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection().BuildServiceProvider();

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => AzureTableGrainStorageFactory.Create(services, "test-provider"));
            Assert.Contains("IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>", ex.Message);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Create_WhenServiceProviderIsNull_ThrowsArgumentNullException()
        {
            // Act & Assert
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => AzureTableGrainStorageFactory.Create(null!, "test-provider"));
        }
    }
}

using System;

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

using Moq;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Orleans.Persistence.AzureStorage;
using Orleans.Runtime;
using Orleans.Storage;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Storage.Tests
{
    public class AzureTableGrainStorageFactoryTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void Create_CallsGetRequiredServiceForIOptionsMonitor()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            var optionsMonitorMock = new Mock<IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>>();
            optionsMonitorMock.Setup(m => m.Get(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(new AzureTableStorageOptions());
            
            services.Setup(s => s.GetRequiredService<IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>>())
                    .Returns(optionsMonitorMock.Object);

            var clusterOptionsMock = new Mock<ClusterOptions>();
            // Mock the extension method by creating a service collection with extension methods available
            var serviceCollection = new ServiceCollection();
            serviceCollection.AddSingleton(clusterOptionsMock.Object);
            var realServices = serviceCollection.BuildServiceProvider();
            services.Setup(s => s.GetService(It.IsAny<Type>())).Returns((Type t) => realServices.GetService(t));

            // Act
            var result = AzureTableGrainStorageFactory.Create(services.Object, "test-provider");
            
            // Assert
            services.Verify(s => s.GetRequiredService<IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>>(), Times.Once);
            Assert.NotNull(result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Create_WhenIOptionsMonitorNotRegistered_ThrowsInvalidOperationException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection().BuildServiceProvider();

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => AzureTableGrainStorageFactory.Create(services, "test-provider"));
            Assert.Contains("IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableStorageOptions>", ex.Message);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Create_WhenServiceProviderIsNull_ThrowsArgumentNullException()
        {
            // Act & Assert
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>("services", () => AzureTableGrainStorageFactory.Create(null!, "test-provider"));
        }
    }
}
